usage: 炸腐皮卷 is a noun used to refer to a specific type of dim sum.
You can use 炸腐皮卷 as the subject or object in a sentence when talking about food.
In Cantonese, 炸腐皮卷 often appears in conversations about meals or dining out.
You can describe the taste or texture of 炸腐皮卷 by adding adjectives before it.
炸腐皮卷 can be used with quantity words or classifiers when ordering or counting.
